entries.german:
1281. 12. November. Apnd Rosenberch. — Heinrich von Rosenberg schenkt dem Stifte Hohenfurt fünf Dörfer nebst einem Wald und tauscht ron eben dem selben gegen drei andere Dörfer das Dorf Sonnberg wieder ein.

XXX. In nomine sanete et indiuidue trinitatis patris et filii el spirilus sancti amen. Cum eorum que geruntur in tempore, obliuio solet me- moriam resecare, necesse est, ea tam testium quam scripture muni- mine conlirmari. Vnde nouerint vniuersi Christi fideles presentes litteras visuri vel audituri, quod ego Henricus de Rosenberch de consensu et voluntate expressa vxoris mee Elyzabeth plurimorumque parentum meorum pro remedio, quod dominus Wocko pie memorie pater meus in dccessn suo pro sao suorumque parentum salute ani- marum ecclesie gloriose perpetueque virginis dei genitricis Marie sue fuudationi scilicet in Altovado ordinauit, fraterque meus Witigo in sua morte confirmando renouauit remedium, scilicet ¡mnuatim sili- ginis modiorum quatuor argenti marcarum decem, venerabili domino Ade abbati totique conuentni ad edificationem dicte ecclesie de Alto vado ordinis Cystercieusis ob reuerentiam sanete trinitatis et glo riose dei genilricis virginis Marie villas subscriptas pleno jure omni- umque meorum posterorum liberorumceterorumque heredummeorum omni contradictione postposita contuli beniuole in perpetuum per- mansuras. Quare predictus dominus Adam abbas eiusque conuentus pro remedio supradicto omnibusque dampnis ex ipsius subtractione remedii eidem ecclesie illatis patrem et fratrem meum pie memorie, me et meos beredes per presentes litferas nunc et in posterum sub gratia mee conscience liberos confirmant et solutos. �?ec autem sunt ville: Nebersyhuew et ea in quaresidebat Olthardus, itemHodennitz, Vzahratky, Oppach cum omnibus harum quinque villarum pertinen- tiis scilicet cum terris pratis herbis nemoribus et pascuis in bosco in montibus in piano in aquis in viis et semitis et omnibus aliis libe- ralitatibus et emunitatibus (sic) suis. Item siluam, que sita est inter Nebersyhuew et metas domini Bauwari, in superscriptarum villarum confirmans libertate. Item pro quadam villa, que vocatur Sunnberch, tres villas scilicet Stoiechingen, et ipsam in qua residebat Brazzlaus, et tertiam plagam domini Gerberti bone memorie, quam exstirpauit Jur, eisdem predicta confirmans libertate libere contuli et benigne. In cuius rei testimonium presentes litteras mei munimine sigilli dedi roboratas. Huius facti sunt testes: Dominus Wernhardus de Schaum- berch, filii eius Henricus Wernhardus , et frater eius Henricus; do minus Hoierius de Lomniz et filius eius Zmielo; Wocko de Witi- genafi, Henricus et Wocko de Chrumnau, Vlricus et Otto fratres de Nouadomo, Henricus de Hôritz, Zmielo de Zmielenberch, Wernhar dus Pibro, dominus Jacobus plebanus inRosenberch, dominus Vlricus plebanus in Predol, dominus Theodericus plebanus in Rosental, dominus Creno purchrauius de Pribenitz, dominus Benata purchrauius de Rosenberch, dominus Andreas, dominus Blasius milites mei, Leu- poldus camerarius, Troianus procurator et fratres sui Tschaztolaus et Bôzlaus; Alwich et frater suus Leutoldus de Vinchenhaim, Virions de Weichselen et frater suus Psedborius, Wutzlaus lilius domini 36 Benate, Tschenko et filius eius Duursat et fratres eius Radozt et o Dominicus; Vlricus deEichorns et frater suus Jan, Rödolfus deGuseii et filius eius Vlricus, Jacobus Ladennicer et frater eius; Vlricus Chreno filius domini Chrenonis, Qual et frater suus Eberhardus filii Oduleni, Syboto judex, et ceteri quam plures. entries.english: In the name of the holy and undivided Trinity, the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, amen. Since things done in time are prone to be forgotten, they must be confirmed by the testimony of witnesses and the protection of writing. Therefore, let all faithful Christians who see or hear this charter know that I, Heinrich von Rosenberg, with the express consent and will of my wife Elisabeth and many of my relatives, have willingly and in perpetuity bestowed full ownership of the following villages upon the venerable Lord Abbot Adam and the whole convent of the Cistercian church of Saint Mary at Hohenfurt. This grant fulfils the spiritual benefit that my father, Lord Woko of blessed memory, established at his death for the salvation of his own soul and those of his parents, and which my brother Witigo renewed and confirmed at his death: namely, an annual offering of four measures of rye and ten marks of silver to the church. In consideration of this benefit and any loss the church has suffered from its withdrawal, the aforesaid Abbot Adam and his convent declare my late father and brother, me, and my heirs released and discharged from that obligation, now and in the future. The five villages are Nebersyhuew; the village in which Olthardus lived; Hodennitz; Vzahratky; and Oppach, with all the appurtenances of those five villages, namely lands, meadows, grasses, woods, and pastures, in forests, mountains, plains, waters, roads, and paths, with all their other liberties and immunities. I also grant the forest situated between Nebersyhuew and the boundaries of Lord Bauwar, with the same liberties as the aforesaid villages. In exchange for the village called Sonnberg, I have also freely and generously granted them three villages—with the liberties stated above—namely Stoiechingen, the village in which Brazzlaus lived, and the estate of the late Lord Gerbert, which Jur cleared. To confirm this, I have issued this charter strengthened by my seal. Witnesses: Lord Wernhard von Schaumberg, his sons Heinrich and Wernhard, and his brother Heinrich; Lord Hoierius von Lomniz and his son Zmielo; Wocko von Witigenau; Heinrich and Wocko von Krumau; the brothers Ulrich and Otto von Nouadomo; Heinrich von Höritz; Zmielo von Zmielenberg; Wernhard Pibro; Lord Jacob, parish priest at Rosenberg; Lord Ulrich, parish priest at Predol; Lord Theoderich, parish priest at Rosental; Lord Creno, Burggraf of Pribenitz; Lord Benata, Burggraf of Rosenberg; Andreas and Blasius, my Ritter; Leupoldus, chamberlain; Troianus, procurator, and his brothers Tschaztolaus and Bôzlaus; Alwich and his brother Leutoldus von Vinchenhaim; Virions von Weichselen and his brother Psedborius; Wutzlaus, son of Lord Benata; Tschenko, his son Duursat, and Tschenko’s brothers Radozt and Dominicus; Ulrich von Eichorns and his brother Jan; Rödolfus von Guseii and his son Ulrich; Jacobus Ladennicer and his brother; Ulrich Chreno, son of Lord Chreno; Qual and his brother Eberhard, sons of Odulenus; Syboto the judge; and many others. Given and enacted at Rosenberg on the day after the feast of Saint Martin, 12 November 1281. The well-preserved seal formerly hung from violet-yellow-red silk, as in no. XXII. Reference: Millauer, p. 82, no. 15.
